summary: What a collection shows when it holds nothing: before first use, or after a filter matched nothing.

slots.when: Only when it says when data appears; under 14 words.
First use only; the action the title points to.

rules.rule: Before first use: 「{object}はありません。」 and the action that adds one, named for it (not 'Get started').
After a filter: 「該当する{object}はありません。」, no create button, the filters kept visible.
The description does not repeat the title.
Order of states: loading, error, empty, content. A section's empty state is compact.

labels.empty_filtered: 該当する{object}はありません。
labels.filtered_hint: 別の条件を試してください。

evidence.source: SmartHR Design System, 空データ
evidence.says: An empty list reads {オブジェクト名}はありません。; a filtered one 該当する{オブジェクト名}はありません。 with 別の条件を試してください。
A first-use empty state has a title and an action matching it; a filtered one says no items match and shows no create button.
An empty state's description does not repeat its heading.
A blankslate in a section is compact.
